departments/valhalla#memos.0: MEMO: Mead is not a stationery item.
departments/valhalla#memos.1: NOTICE: The Einherjar are reminded that the morning battle ends at 11:45, not 'whenever'.
departments/valhalla#memos.2: INCIDENT: A longship was parked in the Intake loading bay overnight. It has been ticketed.
departments/valhalla#memos.3: MEMO: 'Died gloriously' requires two witness statements. A goat is not a witness.
departments/valhalla#memos.4: REMINDER: Shields are to be stored in the rack, not leaned against the filing cabinets.
departments/valhalla#memos.5: MEMO: Ottar's minutes for last week's meeting run to nine verses. A summary has been requested.
departments/valhalla#memos.6: NOTICE: The feasting hall is not a break room. The break room is also not a break room any more.
departments/valhalla#memos.7: INCIDENT: Someone drank the mead reserved for the quarterly review. The review proceeded anyway.
departments/valhalla#memos.8: MEMO: Heroic deaths involving ladders are reviewed case by case and usually declined.
departments/valhalla#memos.9: REMINDER: Brynhildr chooses the slain. She does not choose your parking space. Stop asking.
departments/valhalla#memos.10: MEMO: The east wing extension is finished. It is already full of shields.
departments/valhalla#memos.11: NOTICE: Reincarnation Desk has asked that we stop sending souls back 'for one more fight'.
departments/valhalla#memos.12: INCIDENT: The drinking horn stamp was used on an actual drinking horn. The form is now sticky.
departments/valhalla#memos.13: MEMO: Quartermaster Hjalti reports 400 barrels received and 0 barrels logged. This is an improvement.
departments/valhalla#memos.14: REMINDER: Sagas submitted in place of incident reports will be returned, beautifully, unread.
departments/valhalla#memos.15: MEMO: The annex operates on a hall calendar. Payroll operates on a fiscal one. Neither will move.
departments/valhalla#memos.16: NOTICE: Valhalla is a department of this Bureau. The horns, the fire and the wolves are decorative.
departments/valhalla#memosLate.0: MEMO (FY2+): The auditor asked to see the mead ledger. The mead ledger asked to see the auditor.
departments/valhalla#memosLate.1: NOTICE (FY2+): Post-restructuring, the annex reports directly to Cosmic. The goat remains unassigned.

event-cards#c-wk-great-backlog-x.title: Chief of Pending Items

event-cards#c-wk-tax-season-1.name: Receipt Goblin

event-cards#c-wk-casual-friday-1.name: Aloha Reaper

event-cards#c-wk-sin-envy-1.name: Green-Eyed Cat

event-cards#c-wk-sin-envy-x.title: Director of Comparisons

event-cards#c-wk-sin-gluttony-1.name: Snack Cart Ghoul

event-cards#c-wk-sin-gluttony-2.title: Break-room inspector

event-cards#c-wk-sin-lust-x.flavor: Reviews every attachment with great care. Always signs with a rose.
events#weekly.themes.great-backlog.name: The Great Backlog
events#weekly.themes.great-backlog.blurb: A filing cabinet in Limbo burst. 40,000 souls are loose in the hallway.
events#weekly.themes.great-backlog.staff: Lassoes loose souls with a rope of red tape. Yee-haw, in triplicate.
Used to eat interns. Now only eats paperwork. Mostly.
Has a whistle, a sash and absolutely no authority.
events#weekly.themes.tax-season.name: Tax Season in Purgatory
events#weekly.themes.tax-season.blurb: Everyone died owing something. Everyone wants a receipt.
Keeps every receipt. Every one. Since 1342.
Refuses to use a calculator. Faster anyway.
Who? Who claimed a horse as a dependant?
events#weekly.themes.retrograde.name: Mercury Retrograde Jam
events#weekly.themes.retrograde.blurb: The forms are filing themselves backwards. Nobody can explain it.
Shirt on backwards, walks backwards, files forwards. Usually.
Blames everything on the planets. Is often right.
Sorry about all this. Brought snacks.
events#weekly.themes.lost-socks.name: Lost Socks Amnesty
events#weekly.themes.lost-socks.blurb: Every sock ever lost has arrived for processing. With paperwork.
Speaks for socks who cannot speak. Voice is a bit much.
Made entirely of lost laundry. Smells of fabric softener.
Small, fluffy, everywhere. Sneezes are a hazard.
events#weekly.themes.printer-exorcism.bl: The third-floor printer is possessed again. The queue backs up to Heaven.
events#weekly.themes.printer-exorcism.st: Armed with a spray bottle of holy water and a can-do attitude.
PC LOAD LETTER. It knows what it did.
Lives inside tray 2. Rattles when it is happy.
events#weekly.themes.casual-friday.name: Casual Friday, Eternally
events#weekly.themes.casual-friday.blurb: Hawaiian shirts approved for the rest of time. Productivity: unclear.
events#weekly.themes.casual-friday.staff: Swapped the robe for a flower shirt. Kept the scythe.
Halo tilted at a jaunty angle. Wings in sunscreen.
Blends anything into a smoothie. Do not ask what is in the green one.
events#weekly.themes.valhalla-feast.name: The Feast of Valhalla
events#weekly.themes.valhalla-feast.blur: Odin double-booked the mead hall. Every fallen warrior needs a seat assignment, in triplicate.
events#weekly.themes.valhalla-feast.staf: Flies every fallen warrior to the right bench. Clipboard is also a shield.
Horned helmet, endless drinking horn, perfect posture.
events#weekly.themes.sin-pride.name: Pride Before the Fall
events#weekly.themes.sin-pride.blurb: Every soul insists their file is the most important one. They are all wrong.
events#weekly.themes.sin-pride.staff.0.f: Fans its tail at every form. The forms are not impressed.
events#weekly.themes.sin-pride.staff.1.f: Carries a hand mirror so souls can admire themselves while queueing.
events#weekly.themes.sin-pride.staff.2.f: Wears a tiny crown. Stamps with great dignity.
events#weekly.themes.sin-greed.name: The Greed Ledger
events#weekly.themes.sin-greed.blurb: Souls keep trying to take it with them. Customs is overwhelmed.
events#weekly.themes.sin-greed.staff.0.f: Checks every pocket for coins souls try to sneak through.
events#weekly.themes.sin-greed.staff.2.f: Sleeps on the confiscated gold. Calls it filing.
events#weekly.themes.sin-wrath.name: Wrath Management
events#weekly.themes.sin-wrath.blurb: The complaints department is on fire. Literally, this time.
events#weekly.themes.sin-wrath.staff.0.f: Puts out tempers and desks. Mostly desks.
events#weekly.themes.sin-wrath.staff.1.f: Breathe in. Breathe out. Fill in form 12-C.
events#weekly.themes.sin-wrath.staff.2.f: Whistles when angry. Whistles a lot.
events#weekly.themes.sin-envy.name: Green with Envy
events#weekly.themes.sin-envy.blurb: Everyone wants the afterlife of the soul in front of them.
events#weekly.themes.sin-envy.staff.0.fl: Wants whatever is on your desk. Especially the sunny spot.
events#weekly.themes.sin-envy.staff.1.fl: Copies every stamp it sees. Changes colour to match.
events#weekly.themes.sin-envy.staff.2.fl: Measures the grass on the other side. It is the same grass.
events#weekly.themes.sin-gluttony.name: The Gluttony Buffet
events#weekly.themes.sin-gluttony.blurb: The break-room fridge is missing. All of it. Including the shelves.
Pushes the snack cart. Eats the snack cart.
Found in the fridge. Is now staff. Nobody remembers hiring it.
events#weekly.themes.sin-sloth.name: Sloth Shift
events#weekly.themes.sin-sloth.blurb: Half the queue fell asleep in line. The other half is pretending.
events#weekly.themes.sin-sloth.staff.0.f: Has stamped one form since Monday. Beautifully.
events#weekly.themes.sin-sloth.staff.1.f: Delivers pillows to the queue. Making things worse.
events#weekly.themes.sin-sloth.staff.2.f: Rings every nine minutes, then says never mind.
events#weekly.themes.sin-lust.name: Lust for Paperwork
events#weekly.themes.sin-lust.blurb: Some souls are far too excited about forms. HR has been informed.
events#weekly.themes.sin-lust.staff.0.fl: Shoots arrows at forms that are getting too friendly.
events#weekly.themes.sin-lust.staff.1.fl: Has never been this excited about a stapler. HR has notes.
events#weekly.themes.sin-lust.staff.2.fl: Every approval comes with a rose-shaped stamp and a sigh.
events#weekly.themes.sin-lust.banner.nam: Love Is Blind, Audits Are Not
events#weekly.staff.w-temp.name: Overtime Temp
events#weekly.staff.w-temp.flavor: Has not seen daylight since Tuesday.
events#weekly.staff.w-stapler.name: Temp Stapler
events#weekly.staff.w-imp.name: Mop-Duty Imp
events#weekly.staff.w-imp.flavor: Mopping up a lake of ink, one bucket at a time.
events#specials.halloween.name: Night of the Living Paperwork
events#specials.halloween.blurb: The dead are filing complaints about being dead. Again. The Haunted Records Annex is open until the candles burn out.
events#specials.halloween.staff.hw-ghost: Walks through walls. Still cannot find the stapler.
events#specials.halloween.staff.hw-pumpk: Carves a smile on every form.
events#specials.halloween.staff.hw-vampi: Never sees the sun. Never sees a balanced budget.
events#specials.halloween.staff.hw-headl: Has no head for figures. Signs them anyway.
events#specials.halloween.banner.name: The Witching Hour
events#specials.christmas.name: Holiday Overtime
events#specials.christmas.blurb: The North Pole outsourced its naughty-or-nice list to us. Every soul wants a recount.
events#specials.christmas.staff.xm-elf.f: Wraps every form in a bow. Nobody asked.
Three times, actually. It is a big list.
events#specials.christmas.banner.name: Naughty or Nice
events#specials.newyear.name: Fiscal New Year
events#specials.newyear.blurb: The books close at midnight. Every resolution needs a form, in triplicate.
events#specials.newyear.staff.ny-resolut: Has seen your January. And your February.
events#specials.newyear.staff.ny-party.f: Will be finding glitter until March.
events#specials.newyear.staff.ny-time.fl: Running late. Has been since the dawn of time.
events#specials.newyear.banner.name: Midnight Requisition
events#specials.valentine.name: The Soulmates Registry
events#specials.valentine.blurb: Every soul claims to have a soulmate. Every claim needs a witness and two forms of ID.
events#specials.valentine.staff.vl-cupid: Missed again. Filed an incident report.
events#specials.valentine.staff.vl-choco: Every form comes with a truffle.
events#specials.valentine.banner.name: Love Is Paperwork
events#specials.easter.name: The Resurrection Desk
events#specials.easter.blurb: Someone came back, and now everyone wants to. Applications open for one week only.
events#specials.easter.staff.es-egg.name: Egg Auditor
Has been reborn more times than the printer.
events#specials.easter.banner.name: Second Chances
events#specials.summer.name: Beach Purgatory
events#specials.summer.blurb: Purgatory got a sand budget. The queue now has an ocean view and a lifeguard.
events#specials.summer.staff.sm-crab.fla: Pinches the forms to keep them flat.
events#specials.summer.staff.sm-sun.name: The Sun, Middle Management
events#specials.summer.staff.sm-sun.flav: Takes long lunches. Burns anyone who notices.
events#specials.summer.banner.name: Sun, Sand and Signatures
onboarding#intro.in-decease.caption: FORM 1-A · NOTICE OF DECEASE — You have died. Do not be alarmed; it is quite common.
onboarding#intro.in-queue.caption: Your file has been forwarded to Intake. Please proceed to the counter and wait to be called.
onboarding#intro.in-offer.caption: FORM 2-C · OFFER OF EMPLOYMENT — Position: Intake Clerk (Temporary); duties: stamp; benefits: none.
onboarding#intro.in-stamp.caption: Your predecessor is currently being processed. The desk is yours.
onboarding#training.0.title: Stamp the soul.
onboarding#training.0.text: Then stamp the next one. Souls are the currency here; fifteen Karma Credits hires your first clerk.
onboarding#training.1.title: Hire Dave.
onboarding#training.1.text: Karma Credits pay the staff who stamp for you while you are away.
onboarding#training.2.title: That is the job.
onboarding#training.2.text: Souls pay Karma Credits; Karma hires staff; the Backlog Report pays you when you come back.
onboarding#tips.speed-bar.title: Watch the bar.
onboarding#tips.speed-bar.text: Each fill pays out: the clerk files a batch and you are credited souls and Karma. More staff and milestones make it faster.
onboarding#tips.staff-milestone.title: Milestones, not raises.
onboarding#tips.staff-milestone.text: Every milestone doubles this clerk's speed. The next one is at {next}. Hiring toward it is nearly always the best use of Karma.
onboarding#tips.buy-mode.title: Bulk filing is still filing.
onboarding#tips.buy-mode.text: You can afford more than one hire. ×10 hires ten at once; ×max hires as many as your Karma covers. Handy when a milestone is a few desks away.
onboarding#tips.upgrades.title: An upgrade is affordable.
onboarding#tips.upgrades.text: Upgrades are one-off purchases that speed up a whole department or your stamp. Buy them when you can; they outlast any single hire.
onboarding#tips.offline.title: The office never closes.
onboarding#tips.offline.text: Staff keep working while the app is closed, up to your offline cap. Come back, collect the Backlog Report, spend it on staff, leave again. That is the whole career.
onboarding#tips.dept-unlock.title: A new department has opened.
onboarding#tips.dept-unlock.text: Tap its chip to move desks. Every department you own keeps earning at once, wherever you sit; each has its own staff and upgrades.
onboarding#tips.personnel-intro.title: Requisitions.
onboarding#tips.personnel-intro.text: Vouchers buy personnel cards: one for {pull}, ten for {ten} (a discount, for once).{free} Senior staff are guaranteed within {pity} pulls. The odds are posted at the bottom, as regulations require.
onboarding#tips.equip.title: Put them to work.
onboarding#tips.equip.text: Equipped cards boost output. Duplicates add stars. Tap a card in your Collection to equip it; a card in the drawer helps nobody.
onboarding#tips.stars.title: A duplicate, in triplicate.
onboarding#tips.stars.text: Copies of a card you already own bank toward its next star, and each star makes the card stronger. {card} needs {need} more for its next star. Rarer cards need fewer copies.
onboarding#tips.tasks-intro.title: Daily tasks.
onboarding#tips.tasks-intro.text: Daily tasks pay vouchers. Claim them before midnight, when the list is reshuffled. A skip token writes off one you cannot finish; a finished week pays a bonus.
onboarding#tips.ledger-intro.title: The Annual Audit.
onboarding#tips.ledger-intro.text: An Audit closes the fiscal year: staff, upgrades and departments reset, and you are paid permanent Seals. Each Seal adds 2% to all output forever and buys perks here. File one when progress slows; the next year goes faster.

story#s-first-stamp.title: Welcome to Intake
story#s-first-stamp.text: MEMO: Welcome to Intake. Nobody currently on staff knows where the outgoing tray leads. Please continue stamping.
story#s-deja-vu.title: A Familiar Feeling
story#s-deja-vu.text: MEMO: Mortal realm reporting a spike in déjà vu. Statistically correlated with our throughput. Statistically ignored.
story#s-heaven-capacity.title: Heaven at Capacity
story#s-heaven-capacity.text: NOTICE: Heaven is now open for business and, as of this morning, already at 97% capacity. Please stamp accordingly.
story#s-both-cat-and-ceo.title: A Filing Discrepancy
story#s-both-cat-and-ceo.text: INCIDENT: Soul #4471 was filed as both 'cat' and 'CEO' in the same fiscal quarter. Investigating which form was correct, if either.
story#s-imps-unionise.title: Hell Organises
story#s-imps-unionise.text: MEMO: Hell's imps have unionised. Their first demand is two breaks per eternity. Management is 'reviewing the concept of eternity.'
story#s-auditor-unread.title: Signed, Not Read
story#s-auditor-unread.text: AUDIT FLAG: The Auditor signed this year's report without reading it. The report was, itself, about the Auditor not reading reports.
story#s-fewer-people-somehow.title: Somehow
story#s-fewer-people-somehow.text: MEMO: Throughput is up. Headcount is down. Nobody can explain 'somehow,' and Legal has asked us to stop writing it in memos.
story#s-staffing-lottery.title: Staffing, Reimagined
story#s-staffing-lottery.text: NOTICE: Staffing is now conducted via a sealed requisition pool. HR insists on calling this 'engagement' rather than 'a lottery.'
story#s-shorter-years.title: The Years Shrink
story#s-shorter-years.text: MEMO: Fiscal years are getting shorter. Nobody has approved this, and nobody has explained it. The audits keep coming faster.
story#s-the-wheel-squeaks.title: The Wheel Turns
story#s-the-wheel-squeaks.text: MEMO: The Wheel of Reincarnation has a persistent squeak. Maintenance says it is 'structural' and 'part of the process now.'
story#s-suspiciously-reliable.title: A Pattern Noted
story#s-suspiciously-reliable.text: MEMO: Legal has flagged your attendance record as 'suspiciously reliable.' No action required, just noted. Watched, even.
story#s-shared-tuesday.title: One Tuesday, Shared
story#s-shared-tuesday.text: INCIDENT: Two unrelated souls have filed the exact same memory of a Tuesday. Filing under 'coincidence' pending further review.
story#s-auditor-question.title: A Question, Finally
story#s-auditor-question.text: AUDIT FLAG: The Auditor asked a question this year. Nobody was prepared. The meeting has been rescheduled indefinitely.
story#s-box-seven.title: Box Seven
story#s-box-seven.text: NOTICE: Limbo's Lost & Found has located Box 7. Contents remain classified. The Registrar is, for once, smiling.
story#s-three-daves.title: A Surplus of Dave
story#s-three-daves.text: MEMO: The personnel roster currently lists three separate Daves. All three insist they are the original. All three are correct.
story#s-eternity-kpi.title: Eternity, Quantified
story#s-eternity-kpi.text: MEMO: Eternity is now a tracked KPI. It is trending upward, which management considers both impossible and satisfactory.
story#s-gravity-optional.title: A Brief Lapse
story#s-gravity-optional.text: INCIDENT: Gravity was briefly optional across three departments. Facilities has confirmed it is optional no longer. Mostly.
story#s-unstamped-form.title: One Form Remains
story#s-unstamped-form.text: AUDIT FLAG: The fruit basket has been searched. It contains exactly one unstamped form, and the form has your name on it.
story#s-purpose-returned.title: Purpose, Returned
story#s-purpose-returned.text: NOTICE: Lost & Found has returned a sense of purpose to the front desk. Nobody has claimed it. It is available for pickup.
story#s-backlog-sees-you.title: The Backlog Notices
story#s-backlog-sees-you.text: MEMO: The backlog has reportedly begun noticing individual clerks by name. Management assures staff this is 'not concerning.'
story#s-queue-self-stamps.title: The Queue, Unassisted
story#s-queue-self-stamps.text: INCIDENT: The intake queue has begun stamping itself. Staff are asked not to interfere, and also not to take credit.
story#s-auditor-files-report.title: The Auditor, Unbribed
story#s-auditor-files-report.text: AUDIT FLAG: The Auditor, newly unbribed, has filed a report. The subject of the report is you. It is, regrettably, accurate.
story#s-hr-declares-victory.title: HR Declares Victory
story#s-hr-declares-victory.text: NOTICE: HR has declared the staffing crisis resolved and closed the department. Nobody is sure who will process this notice.
story#s-cosmic-discussed.title: A Discussion, Ongoing
story#s-cosmic-discussed.text: MEMO: 'Cosmic Restructuring' is officially 'being discussed.' The discussion has itself been added to the fiscal calendar.
story#s-pre-approved-souls.title: Pre-Approved
story#s-pre-approved-souls.text: NOTICE: Incoming souls now arrive pre-approved. The stamping is, at this point, largely ceremonial. Please continue anyway.
story#s-auditor-retires.title: Into the Tray
story#s-auditor-retires.text: MEMO: The Auditor has retired. Into the tray. The tray has been relabeled 'Office of the Auditor' out of respect.
story#s-mortal-realm-notices.title: The Realm Takes Notes
story#s-mortal-realm-notices.text: MEMO: The mortal realm has noticed a pattern in your attendance. Several religions have opened a comment thread about it.
story#s-department-is-afterlife.title: The Department, Entire
story#s-department-is-afterlife.text: NOTICE: This department is, as of this filing, functionally the entire afterlife. Please update your business cards accordingly.
story#s-restructuring-in-touch.title: They Will Be in Touch
story#s-restructuring-in-touch.text: MEMO: 'Cosmic Restructuring' will be in touch. No further details available. The calendar has stopped taking new entries.
story#s-stamp-has-your-name.title: Your Name, on the Stamp
story#s-stamp-has-your-name.text: AUDIT FLAG: The stamp has, at some point, acquired your name. Nobody remembers engraving it. It works better than ever.
